headline: Siegfried Mureșan Blames PSD-AUR for Leu Depreciation: "They Created Instability and Economic Uncertainty"
summary: Former designated prime minister Siegfried Mureșan linked the sharp leu depreciation in recent days to the political crisis, including the fall of the Bolojan Government and the rejection of his proposed Cabinet.
why: The leu is Romania's currency, and political instability can weigh on it by raising uncertainty about fiscal policy. Investors watch both politics and currency moves in Romania.
